name: 整列頁首＋標誌左、導覽與功能區右，上下分隔線，往下捲動隱藏
desc: 固定在頂端的整列頁首，下緣有分隔線，導覽連結與功能區之間有直向分隔線；往下捲動隱藏、往上捲動滑回。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，固定在畫面頂端：標誌在左，導覽連結與功能區靠右，所有元素垂直置中排成一列；標誌與功能區分別靠近畫面左右邊緣，只保留少量邊距，比頁面內容寬度更寬。導覽連結明顯比標誌醒目，項目之間間隔寬。功能區可放小型文字切換或圖示按鈕，沒有時省略；有功能區時，導覽連結與功能區之間有一條直向分隔線。頁首下緣有一條橫跨全寬的分隔線。往下捲動時頁首往上滑出隱藏，往上捲動時滑回出現，滑回時疊在內容上方。
mobile: 頁首上只留標誌在左、選單按鈕在右，下緣分隔線保留；導覽連結與功能區收進選單面板：點選單按鈕後，展開蓋住整個畫面的選單面板，頁首留在面板上方、標誌在原位，選單按鈕變成關閉按鈕；導覽連結在面板裡直向排列並靠左，字明顯放大，每個連結之間有橫跨整個畫面寬的分隔線；功能區放在導覽連結下方。往下捲動隱藏、往上捲動滑回的行為保留。觸控裝置上沒有導覽連結的滑過效果。

en.name: Header bar with logo left, navigation and actions right, dividers, hides on scroll down
en.desc: A full-width header bar fixed to the top, with a divider along its bottom edge and a vertical divider between the navigation links and the actions group; it slides away when scrolling down and slides back when scrolling up.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, fixed to the top of the viewport, with the logo on the left, with the navigation links and the actions group on the right, all vertically centered in one row; the logo and the actions group sit close to the left and right edges of the viewport with only a small margin, wider than the page content width. The navigation links are clearly more prominent than the logo, with wide spacing between items. Optionally place a small text toggle or icon buttons in the actions group; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements; when the actions group is present, a vertical divider separates the navigation links from it. A divider spans the full width along the bottom edge of the header. When scrolling down, the header slides up out of view; when scrolling up, it slides back in, overlaying the content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: Only the logo on the left and a menu button on the right stay in the header, and the bottom divider is kept; the navigation links and the actions group move into the menu panel: tapping the menu button opens a menu panel covering the whole viewport, the header stays above the panel with the logo in place, and the menu button turns into a close button; the navigation links are stacked vertically and left-aligned in the panel, clearly enlarged, with a divider spanning the full viewport width between each link; the actions group sits below the navigation links. The hide-on-scroll-down, slide-back-on-scroll-up behavior is kept. Navigation link hover effects do not apply on touch devices.

extras.name: 導覽連結滑過時出現外框
extras.prompt: 滑鼠滑過頁首的導覽連結時，該連結周圍出現一圈外框，滑開後消失，其他連結的位置不變。
extras.tablet: 平板沿用手機版：觸控裝置上取消滑過效果。
extras.mobile: 觸控裝置上取消滑過效果。

en.name: Outline on navigation link hover
en.prompt: When the pointer hovers over a navigation link in the header, an outline appears around that link and disappears when the pointer leaves, without moving the other links.
en.tablet: The tablet follows the mobile layout: the hover effect is removed on touch devices.
en.mobile: The hover effect is removed on touch devices.
